claims.label: Epstein emailed Woody Allen regarding delivery of 23andMe kits to his and Suni's home
claims.claim: A Jeffrey Epstein-authored email states that 23andMe kits had arrived and would be delivered that day to "Woody and Suni" at their home.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the email within the public Epstein files (jmail.world or DOJ releases) to verify recipient identity, date, and full text.

claims.label: Epstein emailed a "Sultan" referencing a person named James Miller and shipping to 9E71st Street
claims.claim: An Epstein email the host shows, addressed 'Hi, Sultan', asks who 'James Miller' is and says 'He is who you have built to'; the host also asks whether the shipping address is Jeffrey's home at 9E71st Street.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the redacted recipient "Sultan" within the Epstein files; cross-reference 9E71st Street as Epstein's New York residence; locate full email chain.

claims.label: Rob Skiba posits Mount Hermon as the 33.33°N × 33.33°E landing site of 200 fallen angels
claims.claim: In a lecture clip, Rob Skiba states that the Book of Enoch identifies 200 Watchers / fallen angels as landing at Mount Hermon in southern Lebanon, and that David Flynn identified this location as 33.33°N by 33.33°E from the Paris prime meridian.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify David Flynn's published coordinate claim independently; cross-check Book of Enoch references to Mount Hermon (Hermon vs. alternate spellings).

claims.label: Rob Skiba posits Gilgamesh as 2/3 God and 1/3 man and links CERN's logo to 666
claims.claim: Rob Skiba states that Gilgamesh was described as two-thirds God and one-third man, that the carbon molecule's 6/6/6 structure equates to the number of man, and that CERN's logo resembles three stacked 6s.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Epic of Gilgamesh text on divine/mortal proportions; confirm CERN logo design and Shiva statue presence at the facility.

claims.label: Tom Horn asserts a special operations general confirmed Gilgamesh remains in "remarkable preservation"
claims.claim: In an Omega Man Radio clip the host plays, Steve Quayle says a special operations general told him Gilgamesh was in 'a state of remarkable preservation' and that they have Gilgamesh's remains; Tom Horn says that, according to some people, the military took possession and control of the dig.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the named general; verify the 2003 Iraq dig records; check whether any official release describes remains transfer.

claims.label: Steve Quayle asserts human genome project aimed at genetic markers to "reanimate" Nimrod/Gilgamesh
claims.claim: Steve Quayle says on Omega Man Radio that the point of the Gilgamesh dig was to extract the DNA, and that he has also been told the human genome project aims to locate genetic markers that would let disembodied spirits reanimate their host body.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Omega Man Radio episode and any prior Quail writings on this thesis; verify against published Human Genome Project mission statements.

claims.label: Tracy Martin states she has been friends with Erika Kirk for nearly 15 years and collaborated on the Romanian Angels project
claims.claim: Tracy Martin states in a video clip that Erika Kirk has been a "dear friend" of hers for "almost 15 years," that they have "done multiple projects together," that Erika wrote the foreword to Martin's book, and that Martin participated in the Romanian Angels gift-distribution project organized by Erika.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify duration of friendship via independent records (project documentation, social media history, foreword publication date); cross-reference Romanian Angels project existence.

claims.label: Tracy Martin states she styled the "left eye club" editorial photograph and designed the cuff Erika Kirk wears
claims.claim: Tracy Martin states she styled the editorial photograph featuring the "left eye club" cuff that has been circulating, and that the cuff and jewelry pieces pictured are her designs.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original editorial publication to confirm styling credit; identify the cuff's commercial availability and Martin's business.

claims.label: Host Reads Epstein Text Chain About Macron's Boyfriend
claims.claim: The host reads a text chain from the Epstein files, which she says is Epstein's, discussing Emmanuel Macron's 'boyfriend' and saying 'along with some other tidbits, I was shown a photo of Macron's boyfriend', and says more emails reference Macron being gay.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the specific text chain and photo within public Epstein files; verify any reference to Macron and an unnamed partner.

claims.label: Frey FA comment draws a parallel between 911 "passport in mint condition" and the "steel neck stopping bullets" narrative
claims.claim: A viewer comment (Frey FA) juxtaposes the 9/11 passport-in-mint-condition story with the steel-neck-stopping-bullets reference in the Charlie Kirk assassination coverage.
claims.investigative_direction: Trace the historical origins of the "passport in mint condition" claim and its media treatment; assess the rhetorical parallel independently.

claims.label: Moderator Marzy comment identifies jmail.world as a Gmail-style interface for viewing the Epstein files
claims.claim: A viewer comment (Moderator Marzy) recommends jmail.world as a tool for viewing the Epstein files in a Gmail-style user interface. Host confirms receipt of similar tips.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the jmail.world site's data source, accuracy of file ingestion, and independent corroboration against DOJ or court-sealed versions.

claims.label: Tatiana comment claims this generation will "live eternal in flesh" as the rationale for an "end human fight"
claims.claim: A viewer comment (Tatiana) posits that the current generation will live eternally in flesh and that this is the underlying purpose of an "end human fight." Host flags a possible typo.
claims.investigative_direction: Ascertain Tatiana's intended phrase; assess consistency with host's prior transhumanism / Nimrod-resurrection framing.

claims.label: Host Taunts Ben Shapiro as "Benjamin" While Reading a Viewer Comment
claims.claim: After reading Angie's comment ("Hi Ben, team Candace for Life"), the host addresses Ben Shapiro as "Benjamin", saying he watches every episode and produces clips from it.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the production-staff role, if any, of "Benjamin" referenced by host; resolve the Ben / Benjamin discrepancy.

claims.label: AZ Masterbaker comment posits COVID tests were instruments of DNA collection for identifying Nimrod's descendants
claims.claim: A viewer comment (AZ Masterbaker) says it fully believes the COVID tests were just to collect DNA, so their accuracy did not matter, and that maybe the DNA collection is to find Nimrod's descendants. The host agrees it is interesting.
claims.investigative_direction: Examine whether COVID PCR / antigen test protocols involved any sample retention for purposes beyond diagnosis; assess whether Nimrod-descendant tracking has any documentary basis.

claims.label: Bobby comment asserts Satan cannot create and only counterfeits, mirroring host's broader framing
claims.claim: A viewer comment (Bobby) states that Satan "has never nor can he ever create anything" and only counterfeits, explaining hostility toward God. Host expands the claim into a general theory of elite imitation.
claims.investigative_direction: This is theological commentary; no factual verification pathway beyond documenting the host-viewer framing alignment.

claims.label: American Jetet comment endorses Rob Skiba's work and frames the conflict as "Babylonian ascension"
claims.claim: A viewer comment (American Jetet) endorses Rob Skiba's work and frames the underlying conflict as a millennia-long battle over "Babylonian ascension."
claims.investigative_direction: Document the convergence of host and viewer framing; assess whether "Babylonian ascension" originates with Rob Skiba, Flynn, or earlier esoteric sources.

claims.label: Host Says She No Longer Believes Erika Was With Her Mother on the Morning of September 10
claims.claim: The host says that, upon further information, she no longer believes Erika Kirk was with her mother on the morning of September 10.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the host's tip sources and any record (calendar, appointment, travel or phone data) placing Erika Kirk and her mother together or apart on the morning of September 10.
claims.transcript_snippet: Upon further information, I no longer believe that she was with her mother on the morning of September 10th.

claims.label: Host Says Macron Is Married to a Man and Media Now Accept Her Earlier Claim
claims.claim: The host says Emmanuel Macron is gay and is married to a man, and that the mainstream media, prompted by the released Epstein emails, are now willing to accept that maybe she was telling the truth.
claims.investigative_direction: Check which mainstream outlets have reported on Macron in the Epstein emails and what the emails actually say; the claim about his marriage restates the host's long-running Brigitte Macron allegation, which is contested in court.
claims.transcript_snippet: They're willing to accept that maybe I was telling the truth. He's also married to a dude because he's gay.

claims.label: Host Says the Epstein Emails Show the Elites Sending One Another 23andMe Kits
claims.claim: The host says the Epstein emails show elites sending one another 23andMe DNA kits, and that she will show two examples.
claims.investigative_direction: Search the public Epstein files for all 23andMe references and list senders, recipients and dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: The 23 andMe emails, the elites sending one another kits.

claims.label: Host Cites Allegation About Woody Allen and His Child
claims.claim: The host says, with the hedge 'allegedly', that she is glad Woody Allen's alleged conduct toward his own child when she was seven is being relitigated.
claims.investigative_direction: The allegation is a matter of public record in court and media coverage; verify against those records. It has no direct bearing on the case.
claims.transcript_snippet: I'm glad that that is being relitigated regarding what he did to his own child when she was seven.

claims.label: Host Says 23andMe Formed in 2005 After the Iraq Invasion
claims.claim: The host says the now-bankrupt company 23andMe came together in 2005, when people began sending in DNA kits, and invites viewers to link it to the military's activity in Iraq.
claims.investigative_direction: Check 23andMe's founding and launch dates and its bankruptcy filing; the host's causal framing is her own inference.
claims.transcript_snippet: in 2005, the now bankrupt company 23 andMe came together where people began sending in those DNA kits to figure out their ancestry.

claims.label: Host Says the US Extracted Gilgamesh's Tomb Roughly Two Years After the Mid-2003 Invasion
claims.claim: The host says the US invaded Iraq in mid-2003 and extracted Gilgamesh's tomb roughly two years later.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify any record of an extraction by US forces; the German geophysicist survey cited in earlier episodes (C-2291) reported a location, not an extraction.
claims.transcript_snippet: we invaded, as I mentioned yesterday, mid 2003 and we extracted Gilgamesh, Gilgamesh's tomb roughly two years later.
